top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is the mature, structurally demonstrated achievement: a small molecule creates a new E3-ligase/substrate interface, shown by ternary-complex structures for both designed bifunctional degraders and thalidomide-type glues. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated recruited degradation and Handa identified cereblon, so one citation worded around the principle covers both arms, including the arm with approved drugs. Ciulli (P001) is a close second but leaves the glue arm without a laureate.
